devotions.titel: The Life Jesus Came to Give
devotions.citaat: I believe that God intends for every one of us to live a life of fulfillment. To live life to the full. To live wholeheartedly.

zinnen.tekst: A life with an internal freedom and peace, full of faith, hope and love. It's the life that Jesus came to give us. How good is that?
